error.descripcion: The rest of the app keeps working: pick another section from the menu on the left, or try again here.

login.tagline: Your video factory in one click.
login.info: Sign in with your Google account to activate your free 10-day trial. We only store your email — your video work never leaves your PC.
login.problemas: Trouble signing in? Write to us at
login.errorInicio: Couldn't open Google. Please try again.

accessDenied.descripcion: {{nombre}} is in closed beta for course students. Your email is not on the access list.
accessDenied.descripcionTrial: Your 10 free days are up. To keep using {{nombre}}, activate your subscription.

create.descripcion: The script editor goes here. This section gets migrated in the next phase.

license.tagline: Your account status and current plan.
license.planActivoDescripcion: You have full access to {{nombre}} with no restrictions. Thanks for supporting the project!
license.trialDescripcion_one: After that day the subscription is $20 USD/month. We'll let you know before it expires.
license.trialDescripcion_other: After those {{count}} days the subscription is $20 USD/month. We'll let you know before it expires.

costs.disclaimer: Prices may change based on each provider's current rates (Fal.ai, Evolink, DubVoice). This catalog reflects prices at the last Vimo update. If you spot a different value, let us know.
costs.tituloVideo: How much each video costs you
costs.tituloImagenes: How much each image costs you
costs.tituloVoces: How much each audio costs you
costs.subtituloVideo: Mix image provider + voice and see total cost for 5/10/20 min.
costs.subtituloImagenes: Compare Fal vs Evolink batch by batch (40 / 220 / 446 images).
costs.subtituloVoces: 1 credit = 1 character in DubVoice. Linear cost based on script length.
costs.notaVideo: * Estimates: narration at ~150 words/min (≈13 chars/sec) · ~1 scene every 7s.
costs.notaImagenes: Columns 40 / 220 / 446 are reference figures for short / medium / long videos.
costs.notaVoces: 1 credit = 1 character. Linear pricing: $11.90 per 1,000,000 characters.

catalogo.cuadrado: Square. Cropped to 16:9 (loses a lot of image).
catalogo.sunoCreditos: ~50–200 credits per generation (varies by model and song length).
catalogo.sunoNotas: Generates 2 variations per call so you pick your favorite. Models: suno-v5-beta (recommended) and suno-v4.5plus-beta. You can choose instrumental or with vocals. Download links are valid for 72 hours.

music.tagline: Generate AI background music in seconds
music.soloEscritorio: Music generation is only available in the desktop app.
music.faltaClave: You need to set up your Evolink key to generate music.

nombre.label: Track name (optional)
nombre.placeholder: e.g.: epic spartan music, soft intro, gym montage…
nombre.hint: Makes it easy to find in your history later; the file is saved under this name.

form.promptPlaceholder: e.g.: chill lo-fi for a cooking video, relaxing acoustic guitar, epic orchestral music…
form.variaciones: Generates {{n}} variations for you to pick from

sugerir.descripcion: Paste your script and the AI proposes a matching music prompt.

chooser.titulo: Pick the version you like best
chooser.sub: Listen to the {{n}} variations we generated. If none convinces you, regenerate to get new ones.

resultado.guardada: It was saved to your history — you'll find it below even after closing and reopening Vimo.

historial.buscar: Search by title, prompt or style…
historial.vacio: Your history is empty. Every track you generate is saved here.
historial.confirmarEliminar: Delete this track from your history?

errores.network: Could not reach the music service. Check your connection.
errores.invalidApiKey: Evolink rejected your API key. Check it in API Keys.
errores.providerError: The music service returned an error. Try again in a few minutes.
errores.taskExpired: The music task expired on the service. Generate again.
errores.timeout: The music was not generated within 10 minutes. Try again.
errores.downloadFailed: Could not download the chosen audio.
errores.llmNetwork: Could not reach the AI service to suggest the prompt.
errores.llmTimeout: The AI took too long to respond. Try again.
errores.llmRateLimited: The AI service is saturated. Wait a few seconds and retry.
errores.llmProviderError: The AI service returned an error. Try again.
errores.missingApiKey: An API key is missing for this action. Set it up in API Keys.
errores.missingProjectsRoot: No projects folder is configured. Check Settings.
errores.sidecar: Could not start the generation engine. Restart the app.
errores.interrumpida: Generation was interrupted when the app closed. If Evolink completed the task, credits were charged anyway — generate again with the same prompt or wait a few minutes.

apiKeys.tagline: Connect your services to generate videos.
apiKeys.soloEscritorio: This section is only available in the desktop app.
apiKeys.faltanDescripcion: Set up at least one key for: {{categorias}}.
apiKeys.opcionalesDescripcion: Alternative providers: one configured key per category is enough.

descripcion.deepinfra: Main AI: generates the visual prompts for each scene.
descripcion.fal: Images with FLUX. The key must be Admin type.
descripcion.evolink: Images with gpt-image (pricier, more realistic). The same key works for AI music.
descripcion.dubvoice: Narrated voice with Minimax. Human quality in Spanish.

errores.keychainUnavailable: Could not access the system's secure storage.
errores.notFound: There is no saved key for this provider.
errores.invalidKey: The key looks invalid or revoked. Check it is complete and has no spaces.
errores.notAdmin: The Fal key is not Admin type. Create a new one choosing the 'Admin' permission.
errores.network: Could not reach the provider. Try again in a moment.
errores.providerError: The provider returned an error. Check the key in its dashboard.
errores.metadataStore: Could not save the key status.
errores.desconocido: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

settings.ubicacionDescripcion: Root folder where Vimo will store your projects. Inside, each project gets its own folder with its scenes, its music and the final video.
settings.soloEscritorio: This section is only available in the desktop app.
settings.errorNoEscribible: That folder is not writable. Pick another one.
